module_summary: Motor controller Moore FSM: pulses f after reset, detects x=1,0,1, then asserts g and latches it on/off depending on y within two cycles.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Nine-state controller register sequencing reset pulse, x pattern detection and y monitoring; decodes f and g.

anchors.name: f
anchors.why: One-cycle motor control pulse decoded from state B.

anchors.name: g
anchors.why: Motor control output asserted in G1, G2 and permanent P1 states.

anchors.name: x
anchors.why: Motor feedback input scanned for the 1,0,1 pattern.

anchors.name: y
anchors.why: Motor feedback input deciding permanent g=1 or g=0.

groups.name: motor_fsm
groups.description: Next-state logic, state register and Moore output decode for f and g.
